snippet.title: Arknights: Endfield Core Chapter [Sanctuary of Ink] Version Trailer
snippet.description:
Dark ink leads to hidden depths, where a painting unfolds to reveal mountains and rivers; towering cliffs cradle cascading waterfalls, while autumn leaves set peaks ablaze.

The stoves at Yuanyuan Manor still burn, and the simple warmth of everyday life rekindles old ties. 

A long-dormant stroke of ink is quietly bleeding into the breeze… Welcome to... No, welcome back to [Si's Painting], Endministrator.
